tagline.en: Global MVNO on O2/EE in the UK — £10 top-up stretches 180 days
tagline.zh: 全球性虚商（英国走O2/EE）——充10镑延长180天

description.en: Lycamobile is a UK-headquartered global MVNO active in 60 countries; in the UK it runs mainly on O2 and EE networks. Order online and pick eSIM at checkout; a top-up extends the number's validity by 180 days (minimum £10). No long-term contract — cancel or change anytime; voucher top-ups supported.
description.zh: Lycamobile是总部位于英国的全球性虚商，在60个国家开展业务；在英国主要使用O2和EE网络。官网直接下单，结账时可选eSIM；每次充值延长号码有效期180天，最低充值10英镑。无长期合约，可随时取消或更改，支持充值卡密充值。

details.en:
Lycamobile is the call-centric global MVNO: its bundles skew toward international minutes rather than China-roaming data, and its keep-alive is top-up based — £10 per 180 days, worse value than giffgaff's £0.30 SMS or VOXI's £5. The upside is familiarity and reach: it operates in 60 countries, so the same account logic works for relatives abroad, and voucher-based top-ups (scratch cards) exist where cards aren't an option. eSIM can be selected during bundle purchase on the official site. No contract lock-in.

Trade-offs: mainland-China roaming is not its design centre (the source review does not recommend it for China-roaming cloud residents); network priority as an MVNO sits below host-network subscribers; and bundle-heavy marketing means the cheapest keep-alive path is simply topping up and not buying anything.
details.zh:
Lycamobile是以通话为中心的全球性虚商：套餐偏国际通话分钟而非回国流量，保号走充值制——每180天充10英镑，成本高于giffgaff的0.3镑短信或VOXI的5英镑。优势是规模与触达：业务覆盖60个国家，海外亲属也能用同一套账户逻辑，没有信用卡时可用充值卡密。

官网购买套餐时可直接选eSIM，无长期合约锁定。取舍：中国大陆漫游并非其设计场景（源盘点不推荐云居民为漫游首选）；虚商网络优先级低于宿主网络用户；

营销以套餐为主，最省的保号路径是只充值不购套餐。

bestFor.en: Users who mainly call internationally and want a no-contract UK number with voucher top-up options.
bestFor.zh: 以国际通话为主、想要无合约英国号码并支持卡密充值的用户。
